brief:
Spain's High Court released pro-Palestinian donor and US media heir James Cox Chambers Jr. on conditional bail Friday while considering an American extradition request, Al-Monitor reported. The court imposed unspecified conditions on his release as it deliberates the U.S. government's bid to extradite him.

Chambers, who inherited a media fortune, has been a prominent financial supporter of pro-Palestinian causes. The extradition proceedings remain ongoing in the Spanish court system.
dek: By Emma Pinedo MADRID, Nov 20 (Reuters) - Spain's High Court has released pro-Palestinian donor and US media heir James Cox Chambers Jr.
title: Spanish court releases US media heir Chambers on conditional bail
